title: Netherite Recipes
description: This Project adds crafting recipes for netherite tools and armor.
body:
This adds recipes for Netherite Armor and tools. With this datapack you dont need to spend a diamond on a netherite spear or shovel, or you can flex on your friends that you can craft a netherite chestplate using only netherite and no diamonds.
Here are the recipes:
